title: KW T909 Custom Built Hi-tensile Aluminium FUPS Bullbar #24
description: Kenworth T909 high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS Bullbar. 100mm one piece main cross pipes passing through drilled uprights for maximum strength, no butt welds. 100mm box uprights shown. Reversible aluminium road train signs. Provision for removable Over Size signs. Extra deep main channel. Polished aluminium tow pin surround and provision for recessed number plate. Indicator/daylight running lights mounted in outer box uprights. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
